hook: HYDRAA reclaims *4 acres* of Sandapalli lake near Shamshabad
hook_b: HYDRAA reclaims *4 acres* of Sandapalli lake near Shamshabad
tldr: HYDRAA removed walls and lawns built into Sandapalli lake in Tondipalli village, Shamshabad mandal, on Saturday, Nov 21, per Siasat.

beats.what: Officials razed boundary walls around the lake and a house inside its FTL, then put up 1,600 metres of fencing and a notice marking the land as lake property.
beats.why: HYDRAA was alerted to construction inside the 76-acre lake and confirmed it with irrigation officials before acting.
beats.care: The fenced line now marks where the lake ends, for anyone buying or building around Tondipalli.

causes.label: Walls, lawns built into the lake

effects.label: Notice says land belongs to lake
